notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now — if you feel very unwell, drowsy, or have no one to drive you, call 911 instead of driving yourself. Fever with a bad headache, stiff neck and light sensitivity can mean a serious infection around the brain that needs urgent testing and treatment today. While you are still able, call 911 if a rash appears or you feel worse on the way. If anyone is with you, ask them to call 911 immediately if you become confused, have a seizure, or are difficult to wake.
